title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The correct value of R_c must be provided as R_c = 2*sqrt(Km).

title: Equation of Motion
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly write the equation of motion m*ddot{x} + R*dot{x} + K*x = 0.

title: Indicial Equation
description: Important Criteria: The derivation of the indicial equation m*alpha^2 + R*alpha + K = 0 must be shown.

title: Critical Damping Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The explanation of critical damping and its relation to R_c must be included.

title: Initial Conditions Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student should discuss how initial conditions affect the approach to equilibrium for R > R_c and R < R_c.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the derivation of alpha and the conditions for damping.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all terms in the equations are dimensionally consistent.

title: Alternative Approaches
description: Optional Criteria: Mentioning any alternative methods to solve the problem or verify results would be beneficial.
